cells.gaps: No source found since October 2023 says the system checks fingerprints, face or iris to stop one person enrolling twice; the Director-General calls the NINs non-duplicable.
cells.note: Stage 3: the NCRA's biometric system has registered about 93 per cent of the population, each with a unique NIN (August 2026). The Director-General's word that NINs are non-duplicable does not show enrolments checked for duplicates, as for Guinea, so stage 4 is not met.
